relations: Shifting cloud material across the gap subtly reshapes the illuminated edges of the opening.

caption: The video captures an elevated view over a low-rise commercial-industrial area beneath a dramatic dusk sky, with the framing essentially unchanged. A thin orange band lights the horizon behind silhouetted hills, while a thick grey cloud deck covers the upper sky. The sun is mostly concealed behind this layer but breaks through a horizontal gap on the right of centre, throwing a fan of crepuscular rays downward over the rooftops. As time passes, the brightest part of the gap shifts slightly toward a more central position. The fan of rays grows brighter and more concentrated, narrowing and pointing more vertically. The illuminated edges of the gap subtly reshape as cloud material shifts across the opening, while the foreground buildings, roads and horizon keep constant positions.
